🌟 OpenTV-Remote | Kotlin
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide users with a free, open-source, and highly customizable smart TV remote control application for their Android and iPhone devices, enabling local network control of various smart TVs.
✨ Key Features: • Free and open-source (MIT License) • No subscription, ads, or account required • Automatic network discovery
📖 Summary: OpenTV-Remote is a free, open-source mobile application for Android and iPhone that functions as a smart TV remote. It offers custom layouts, local Wi-Fi control, and supports English and Russian languages, with a focus on providing a seamless and user-friendly remote experience without requiring subscriptions or accounts.
